technology_type.value: affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics
technology_type.evidence: Using mass spectrometry-based immunopeptidomics, we demonstrated that macrophages pulsed with FVIII-AnxA5 fusion proteins efficiently processed and presented FVIII-derived peptides on HLA-DR molecules.
Mass spectrometry raw data (Xcalibur format) were analyzed using both Proteome Discoverer 2.2 (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany) and the FragPipe pipeline (v20.0) incorporating MSFragger (v3.8).
